description: This C# source file defines a static helper class 'ImageHelper' within the 'PdfSharp.Drawing' namespace, providing methods for processing image files, specifically creating WPF bitmap sources from GDI images. It contains platform-specific code, conditioned by preprocessor directives, to handle different graphics APIs (GDI and WPF) and various image formats.

classes.name: ImageHelper
classes.description: A static helper class providing methods to process images, notably creating a WPF BitmapSource from a GDI Image object, supporting various image formats via format-specific decoders.

methods.name: CreateBitmapSource
methods.description: Creates a WPF BitmapSource from a System.Drawing.Image object by saving it to a memory stream in the appropriate format based on the image's raw format GUID, then decoding it using the corresponding WPF bitmap decoder. Supports BMP, PNG, JPEG, GIF, TIFF, and ICON formats.
